basics.description: **Aegis — Workloads Platform** deploys an in-boundary, keyless platform that discovers, validates and observes your multi-layer Azure workloads **entirely inside your own subscription**. No PHI/PII leaves your boundary. Every component runs as its own Managed Identity — no secrets are collected here.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: All resources are co-located in this single region (data residency by construction).

elements.name: containerRegistry
elements.label: Container Registry name
elements.toolTip: Azure Container Registry name (without .azurecr.io) the platform images are pulled from. Must be globally unique; created if absent. Images must be present for a turnkey pull.

elements.name: imageTag
elements.label: Image tag
elements.toolTip: Image tag to deploy (usually the release tag).

elements.name: authMode
elements.label: API authentication mode
elements.toolTip: Phase-1 delivered default is 'Disabled' — safe ONLY because the API is internal-only (network-isolated, not publicly exposed). 'Required' validates an Entra bearer token on every API request and is the hardening path (issue #127); it MUST be enabled before exposing the API publicly.

elements.name: authTenantId
elements.label: Entra tenant (directory) id
elements.toolTip: Non-secret tenant GUID the API validates tokens against. Required when authentication mode is 'Required'.

elements.name: authAudience
elements.label: API token audience
elements.toolTip: Non-secret API app registration Application ID URI or client id (e.g. api://aegis-workloads-platform). Required when authentication mode is 'Required'.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the API Application ID URI or client id.

elements.name: manageStateImmutabilityPolicy
elements.label: Manage state WORM immutability policy from IaC
elements.toolTip: Keep 'Yes' unless the state-container immutability (WORM) policy has been LOCKED out-of-band, after which Azure rejects further updates — then choose 'No'.
